title: Twig 4.0.0-beta1 released
content:
<html><head></head><body>Six months after the first alpha, Twig 4.0 reaches beta. Since then, the 3.x
branch has deprecated many legacy behaviors, and this beta removes them all:
sandboxed templates get an environment of their own, macros become as strict as
functions, and several…</body></html>
author: Fabien Potencier
